items.title: Other cards can deliver many Centurion perks
items.why: Competitor cards can match much of Centurion's lounge value, so partner packaging matters more than exclusivity.
items.summary_ai: An analysis finds several non-Amex cards can replicate many Centurion lounge and travel perks.
items.take: Competitor cards can match much of Centurion's lounge value, so partner packaging matters more than exclusivity.
